items.quote: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the `clay-api-key` header.
items.why: Quote states API key required in header; key part of api_key auth claim.

items.quote: There are two ways to use Clay as a developer: install the agent plugin to build with Clay inside your coding agent, or call the Public API directly from your own applications and services.
items.why: Quote names agent plugin and Public API as two ways; no resources, base URL or breadth.

items.quote: Find companies and people in Clay's proprietary GTM database.
items.why: Quote mentions searching companies/people in GTM database; no platform description or other resources.

items.quote: Use MCP to call Clay functions from a coding agent like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
items.why: Quote says use MCP to call Clay functions from coding agents; implies MCP server. Vendor-official not shown.

items.quote: The developer platform is available across all Clay plans, including free and trial plans.
items.why: Quote directly states developer platform available on all plans, including free and trial.

items.quote: The default limit is **300 requests per minute per workspace** (about 5 requests per second), shared across all API keys and OAuth credentials in the workspace.
items.why: Quote is a rate limit (300 req/min per workspace); says nothing about plan gating or self-serve access.
